parts.note: Grey is the limiting colour (2.6/4 = 0.65 per part < 0.75 blue, 0.889 white); 15 x 0.65 = 9.75 litres; both give 9.75 litres. Checked: uses 1.3 l blue and 5.85 l white, within stock.

key_verdict: No disagreement; the setter's key is correct in every part.
why: Three-part ratio question with SEAB's own imperatives (Find / Express in the form 1 : n), clean numbers, and a genuine 2-mark limiting-quantity reasoning step in (c); the only shared feature with an exemplar is the standard '1 : n' phrasing of 2009 P1 Q21(c), which is syllabus rubric, not a re-skin, and no exemplar uses a three-ingredient mixture with stock limits.
